title: Confucius and harmony
examples: What does Confucius mean by living in harmony?
How is 'ren' different from just being polite?
Does respecting your family mean you never disagree with them?

explain.say: Confucius taught that a good life involves maintaining harmony in your community.

items: Harmony means things work well together.
It is about balance between people.

explain.say: One key idea is respect, which means showing proper regard for others.
Family relationships are very important to Confucius, especially showing care to elders.
Ren is a central concept; it means genuine humaneness or benevolence towards others.
The golden rule suggests treating others as you would like to be treated yourself.
In daily life, if you see a friend struggling with a heavy bag, you show ren by helping them.

faq.q: What is the main difference between ren and just being polite?
faq.a: Politeness is just showing good manners on the surface. Ren is about deep, genuine feeling of care inside.
asks: Does ren mean I have to say nice things?

faq.q: Does respecting my parents mean I cannot disagree with them?
faq.a: No, respect means valuing them even when you have different ideas. You can disagree while still showing deep respect.
asks: Can I argue with my parents and still be respectful?
Is disagreement bad for family harmony?

faq.q: Is the golden rule only for people I know?
faq.a: No, the golden rule applies to everyone, even people you do not know well. It is a universal guide for action.
asks: Do I only follow the golden rule for friends?
Does the golden rule apply to strangers?

faq.q: How does filiality connect to harmony?
faq.a: By honoring your family, you learn how to respect social roles, which helps keep the wider community harmonious.
asks: Is family respect the start of harmony?
Does caring for family make me a better citizen?

faq.q: Can I be harmonious if my family members argue often?
faq.a: Harmony is a goal, not a constant state. It requires ongoing effort from everyone involved to keep improving.
asks: What do I do when my family is not harmonious?

facts: Confucius emphasized that proper social roles help maintain order.
Filial piety is the deep respect shown to one's parents and ancestors.
Ren is often translated as benevolence or humaneness.
The golden rule is a moral principle found in many cultures.

quiz.say: If you see someone struggling, helping them shows:
quiz.why: Ren means showing genuine humaneness, which is what helping someone shows.

wrong.1: Respect is about acknowledging worth, but ren is about action of kindness.
wrong.2: Filial piety is specifically about family members showing care to elders.
wrong.3: Harmony is the result, but ren is the quality of action that creates it.

quiz.say: What is the core idea behind the golden rule?

options.show: Treat others as you wish to be treated.
options.say: Treat others as you wish to be treated.

options.show: Only treat people who are nice to you.
options.say: Only treat people who are nice to you.

quiz.why: This rule requires you to put yourself in someone else's shoes first.

wrong.1: This is selfish and ignores how others feel.
wrong.2: This creates a cycle of only getting what you give.
wrong.3: Politeness is good, but the golden rule demands deeper empathy.

quiz.say: Showing deep care for your parents is called:
quiz.why: Filial piety is the specific term Confucius used for this deep family respect.

wrong.1: Respect is too general; filial piety names the specific duty.
wrong.2: Ren is the feeling, but filial piety is the practice in the family.
wrong.3: Harmony is the outcome, not the action itself.
